faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in April?
faq.a: April in Marbella averages 20°C air temperature, with highs around 22°C and lows of 14°C. Sea temperature is 18°C. You'll get about 6 hours of sunshine per day, and rainfall averages 5 days for the month. It's a pleasant spring month, ideal for cruising rather than heavy swimming.

faq.q: Is it warm enough to swim in Marbella in April?
faq.a: The sea temperature in April is 18°C, which is cool but not freezing. Some swimmers do take a dip, especially on sunny afternoons. If you're sensitive to cold, a wetsuit helps. Most guests prefer to enjoy the views, sunbathe on deck, and save swimming for May or June when the sea warms to 20°C+.

faq.q: What should I wear on a yacht charter in April?
faq.a: Layers are key. Pack a light jumper or jacket for the morning/evening, plus a t-shirt and shorts for midday. Non-slip shoes, sunglasses, and sunscreen are essential. A windbreaker is useful if you're heading offshore. Evenings can be cooler, so bring a light scarf or hoodie.

faq.q: Is Easter a good time for a yacht charter in Marbella?

faq.q: What sea conditions can I expect in April?
faq.a: April seas are generally calm, with average wave heights of 0.5–1m. The Mediterranean is sheltered, so conditions are ideal for cruising. April offers mild spring sunshine, calm seas, and fewer crowds than summer – perfect for a relaxed cruise from Puerto Banús. Whether you're after a sunset sail or a family day trip, here's what you need to know.

April Weather Averages in Marbella

April in Marbella is spring at its best. Average air temperature reaches 20°C, with daytime highs of 22°C and overnight lows of 14°C. Sea temperature sits at 18°C – refreshing but not peak swimming season. You'll enjoy around 6 hours of direct sunshine per day, with daylight lasting about 9 hours. Rainfall is minimal: only 5 days on average, mostly as short showers. The sea is typically calm, with wave heights of 0.5–1m.

Easter 2032 Dates & Charter Tips

Easter 2032 runs from 27 March to 3 April. This is a popular period, so book early – especially for premium yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94. Smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are great for groups of up to 11 guests. Easter week sees mild weather, with occasional cloud but plenty of sun. Expect calm seas and light winds, ideal for coastal cruising to Cabopino or Estepona.

Best Boats for an April Charter

For April, we recommend:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h or €2,299/8h) – cosy and affordable
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, same pricing) – great for families
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, €4,719/4h with jet ski) – spacious and wind-protected
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax, pricing on request) – luxury for larger groups

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, cava, light snacks, insurance, and VAT. Departures are from Puerto Banús.

What to Wear & Pack for April

Layers are essential. Pack a light jacket or hoodie for mornings and evenings, plus t-shirts and shorts for midday. Non-slip boat shoes, sunglasses, and sunscreen (SPF 30+) are a must. A windbreaker is useful if you head offshore. Don't forget a swimsuit – even if the sea is 18°C, sunbathing on deck is a highlight.

Best Routes & Destinations in April

April's calm seas make it perfect for coastal cruising. Popular routes include:

  • Puerto Banús to Cabopino – 30 min, sandy beaches and dunes
  • Puerto Banús to Estepona – 45 min, charming old town and marina
  • Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro – 20 min, quiet cove for anchoring
  • Sunset cruise along the Golden Mile – views of La Concha mountain

For a longer trip, head to Sotogrande (1 hour) or even Gibraltar (2 hours) on a clear day.

Water Sports & Activities

April is great for water sports. The Mangusta 80 charter includes a free jet ski. Paddleboarding and snorkelling are possible – the water is clear, though a wetsuit helps. For adrenaline, try towing an inflatable behind a speedboat or the Bandido. Always check with your skipper for real-time conditions.

Booking Tips for April 2032

Book at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially for Easter week. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on larger yachts. Smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 are available at fixed rates. Remember, all charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance – no hidden costs. For the best experience, aim for a midday or sunset slot to enjoy the mild temperatures.
